instrument: Virginia SCC Final Order, Case No. PUR-2025-00058 (Rate Schedule GS-5)
summary: GS-5 contracts run 14 years for customers signing an ESA on or after January 1, 2027, with an optional ramp period of up to four years at a minimum 20% annual ramp; minimum charges continue if service continues past the contract term.
text: The contract provisions shall apply to customers taking initial service and signing an ESA on or after January 1, 2027. The contract term shall be 14 years. A customer may also include, within the contract term, a load ramp period not to exceed four years (with a minimum annual ramp of 20%). If the customer continues to take service after the conclusion of the contract term, the minimum charges approved herein shall continue.

source.citation: Virginia State Corporation Commission, Final Order, Case No. PUR-2025-00058, Application of Virginia Electric and Power Company for a 2025 biennial review, entered November 25, 2025 (Doc. Con. Cen. No. 251140150)

notes: The post-term continuation of minimum charges is not reported in any secondary account located. Upgraded from ASSERTED/NOT_CHECKED (2026-09-20).
